raiders: Hooked skiffs close on the cargo rail; their goal is theft and escape.
creature: A broad-backed river grazer holds the rudder shoal. Height, bait or spaced strikes can free the vessel.
lure: Mineral resonance makes familiar voices seem to call from the wrong bank. Chart, chain and named witnesses remain reliable.
boarders: A bowman holds the upper rail while a hook bearer approaches the stair. Break the lane, divide them across decks or buy passage.
hold-thieves: A hold thief seeks a counted shipment below while a net bearer covers the hatch. Recover the physical lot before it escapes.
storm: Wind works a cracked upper stay. The rigging at 55,10,+1 needs bracing; leaving it risks the hull and loose cargo.
shoal: Newly deposited silt narrows the sounding. A slower pilot passage saves the hold; forcing it risks the hull.
driftwood: Useful timber drifts past a broken carrier raft. A rope can secure one lot, but exposure delays the route.
galley-fire: Lamp oil catches beside the galley. Water and the galley fire cover can smother it; smoke can reach the hatch.
split-seam: A lower seam admits water. The lower repair stores at 20,15,-1 can seat a brace before the hold takes more water.
flooded-hold: Water has followed the cargo hatch below. Work the bilge at 8,15,-1 or accept damage and abandoned cargo.
inspection: A river work patrol asks whose claim supports the cargo. Witnesses, paper or a declared payment can settle the inspection.

variants.name: Shortage skiffs
variants.cause: A recorded market shortage gives loose cargo an immediate buyer.
variants.effect: A third lot-caller boards; conceding can cost a second lot.
variants.counterplay: Repel the staged group, misdirect it, or let fitted rail netting catch the first loss.

variants.name: Displaced breeding pair
variants.cause: Altered aftermath work has shifted a territorial pair into the rudder shoal.
variants.effect: Two animals hold separate deck approaches and bait requires two fish lots.
variants.counterplay: Use spaced reach, pilot the narrow water, or pay the disclosed two-lot bait cost.

variants.name: Returning resonance
variants.cause: A prior answering or Jomon's conspicuous fitted signal gives the mineral echo a remembered pattern.
variants.effect: Signal navigation takes a second action and leaves a named route account.
variants.counterplay: Anchor materially, counsel named crew, or accept the visible signal record.

variants.name: Obligation claim
variants.cause: An unsettled institutional obligation has been sold to a boarding company.
variants.effect: A claimant joins the boarding and offers a finite account settlement.
variants.counterplay: Take the decks, surrender cargo, or settle one real obligation before boarding.

variants.name: Marked shortage lot
variants.cause: A heavily loaded hold makes one regional shortage worth marking in advance.
variants.effect: The thief targets the most demanded carried commodity and arrives through net drag if fitted.
variants.counterplay: Intercept the physical lot, exploit the fitted net, or abandon the declared claim.

variants.name: Crosswind stay
variants.cause: Severe route exposure or present storm weather loads two sides of the upper rig.
variants.effect: Emergency station work takes an extra exposed action and two supports appear.
variants.counterplay: Brace either support directly, fit a backstay, or spend the disclosed longer station work.

variants.name: Returning silt tongue
variants.cause: A previously travelled edge now carries a newly legible deposit across its old sounding.
variants.effect: Careful sounding takes two extra actions; forcing costs one extra hull integrity.
variants.counterplay: Use keel shoes to recover one measure, accept delay, or accept the disclosed scrape.

variants.name: Fire-marked carrier raft
variants.cause: A recorded regional fire left charcoal lashed among the drifting timbers.
variants.effect: Rope recovery takes one extra action but yields a wet timber lot and a charcoal lot.
variants.counterplay: Claim both physical lots with rope or leave the dangerous salvage unclaimed.

variants.name: Grease-soaked galley store
variants.cause: Carried wool or charcoal has trapped lamp grease and sparks beside the galley.
variants.effect: A second fire starts and station work takes one extra exposed action.
variants.counterplay: Extinguish sparse fires directly or use the fitted cover to recover one action.

variants.name: Worked seam reopens
variants.cause: Low integrity or a recorded repair loads an older hull seam instead of clean timber.
variants.effect: The seam begins wetter and weaker; station work takes an extra exposed action.
variants.counterplay: Brace the sparse support, use strainers to recover one action, or repair after passage.

variants.name: Thaw surge
variants.cause: Spring high water or winter ice pressure drives water through more than one opening.
variants.effect: Two lower-deck cells flood and emergency work takes an extra exposed action.
variants.counterplay: Pump the whole deck, redirect water, or use strainers to recover one action.

variants.name: Counterclaim inspection
variants.cause: An outstanding institution account gives the patrol a second plausible claimant.
variants.effect: Witness trust needs one additional level and a cash settlement costs three credit.
variants.counterplay: Produce stronger trust, a physical paper lot, the signal shutter, or pay the stated account.

echoes.title: Hooks remembered at the next mooring
echoes.consequence: a local cargo thief arrives with one extra finite supply, but names the marked shortage lot

echoes.title: Tracks beside Jomon's wake
echoes.consequence: the receiving region records where the displaced pair settled, changing its population margin

echoes.title: The answer repeated correctly
echoes.consequence: two household adults compare the false voice with Jomon's named signal and trust the shared watch

echoes.title: The boarding paper comes ashore
echoes.consequence: the receiving work account records the settled or refused obligation instead of forgetting it

echoes.title: A cut mark on the surviving lot
echoes.consequence: the most demanded local cargo gains a witnessed claim and one point of market confidence

echoes.title: The stay's pale working scar
echoes.consequence: the upper rig keeps a visible repair mark and the next storm station estimate is clearer

echoes.title: A second sounding on the old line
echoes.consequence: the destination chart gains the new silt note and one point less hidden shoal risk

echoes.title: Charcoal knots at the landing
echoes.consequence: the local contact recognises the fire-marked salvage and records its origin

echoes.title: The scrubbed galley board
echoes.consequence: the galley retains an inspectable smoke scar and a counted fire-cover drill

echoes.title: The seam entered in the household share
echoes.consequence: the carpenter-minded adult records the repair and improves one strained relationship

echoes.title: Thaw water in the next account
echoes.consequence: the destination receives a visible high-water forecast rather than an untelegraphed penalty

echoes.title: The counterclaim finds a witness
echoes.consequence: the destination account records who accepted the inspection and adjusts one obligation

refits.name: Galley fire cover
refits.effect: Galley fire starts with less fuel; emergency work and meals take one fewer action.
refits.drawback: The cover occupies dry wool that cannot be traded.

refits.name: Twin bilge strainers
refits.effect: Flood crises admit less initial water and pumping takes one action.
refits.drawback: Strainers do not repair an open hull seam.

refits.name: Storm backstay
refits.effect: Storm supports start stronger and emergency work no longer requires a readied rope.
refits.drawback: A failing stay still needs the courier at its physical upper-deck station.

refits.name: Cargo rail netting
refits.effect: The first cargo loss in each voyage is caught and deck thieves start entangled.
refits.drawback: Cut netting makes the next loss ordinary; it does not defeat boarders.

refits.name: Sounding keel shoes
refits.effect: Careful shoal work takes one fewer action and a forced scrape costs one integrity.
refits.drawback: The extra iron makes severe mineral resonance more conspicuous.

refits.name: Winter hatch felt
refits.effect: Winter route exposure falls and aboard floodwater does not chill the courier.
refits.drawback: Felt does not prevent wetness, load, or regional cold.

refits.name: Signal mast shutter
refits.effect: Named signals answer lure and inspection voyages without specialist support.
refits.drawback: The visible answer records Jomon on the route account.

refits.name: Sickbay sling cot
refits.effect: A berth treatment can spend wool and six actions to clear one persistent injury.
refits.drawback: Treatment consumes time and material; it does not restore lost health.

refits.name: Vessel field forge
refits.effect: The repair station can smelt and forge finite material while Jomon is moored.
refits.drawback: Heavy hot work is unavailable during a voyage or deck crisis.

refits.name: Vessel glass still
refits.effect: The galley can brew and distil finite carried ingredients while moored.
refits.drawback: Its vessels still need gathered reagents and empty physical flasks.

refits.name: Vessel gunworks
refits.effect: The storage station can fabricate guns and counted fictional charges while moored.
refits.drawback: Loud work and finite stock never create free ammunition.
